Tess (AE): Kicking off thread for ACME sealed POC asks. Two procurement items: 1) clear on whats included in the onprem support add-on, and 2) upgrade/rollback expectations for sneakernet deliveries.
Marco (SE): From technical call: they want to avoid full-image reinstalls for patching. Request: differential delta bundles + pre-signed rollback artifacts. Also need an offline verification flow so their change board can validate before applying.
Raj (ACME Infra): Confirming constraints: limited outbound connectivity, strict change windows (weekly windows only), and GRC requires a notarized artifact for each bundle.
Hana (Security): We can provide a notarized manifest signed with timestamping (RFC3161) plus per-bundle SBOM. Verification flow we recommend for airgapped sites:
```
1) Check integrity: `sha256sum bundle-v2.0.tar.gz` and compare to notarized manifest
2) Verify signature: `redwood-verify --bundle bundle-v2.0.tar.gz --cert redwood-ca.pem`
3) Validate SBOM: `sbom-validate --file sbom-v2.0.json`
4) Run sandbox smoke: `./tools/airgap-smoke.sh --bundle bundle-v2.0.tar.gz`
```
Tess (AE): Procurement asked whether onprem support covers validation automation or if that's PS. They also want to know how many emergency hotfixes are included in the support add-on.
Nora (Legal): Contract note: we should define an "Airgap Validation" SOW line item. Standard support will include documentation and remote guidance; bespoke site automation and on-site dry runs are PS. We can include up to 2 emergency hotfixes/year in the premium onprem support bundle.
Marco (SE): Technical detail: our delta bundles are encoded as "patch.tar.gz" that contains a `manifest.json` with `base_hash` and `target_hash`. Installer will abort if `base_hash` != local hash. We also include a pre-signed rollback archive `rollback-<id>.tar.gz` stored under `/opt/redwood/rollback/`. Installer will auto-restore if postinstall healthcheck fails for >15 minutes.
Raj (ACME Infra): 15 minutes seems short for our change board. Can we increase to 60 minutes? Also need a manual approval gate before rollback for compliance.
Hana (Security): We can expose two knobs: `--auto-rollback-threshold-minutes=NN` and `--require-manual-rollback-approval=true/false`. For POC we recommend auto-rollback enabled with 30-minute threshold, and an audit log shipped in the bundle.
Marco (SE): Additionally, for bandwidth constrained locations we can supply consolidated quarterly delta sets that include multiple micro-deltas combined. That reduces shipping events.
Tess (AE): Pricing follow-up: premium onprem support = yearly fee on top of the reserved license. Includes: priority support, 2 hotfixes/year, and remote validation guidance. Onsite dry runs and extra hotfixes billed at PS rate. Procurement asked for PS rate numbers.
Nora (Legal): Provide PS day rate in the SOW and state that extra hotfixes will be quoted and scheduled as PS engagements. Also include acceptance criteria for any hotfix: signed bundle, SBOM attached, passes smoke harness.
Raj (ACME Infra): Auditors will want the cert fingerprint and the timestamp authority details. Can you supply OCSP/CRL info for the signing certs?
Hana (Security): Yes. We'll attach the cert sha256 fingerprint, CA chain, and OCSP responder URL. For high-assurance customers we can also output OCSP stapled responses inside the notarized manifest.

Tess (AE): Action items: Marco to add an appendix with installer flags and example `manifest.json`; Hana to attach cert fingerprint + sample notarized manifest; Nora to add SOW language for 2 included hotfixes/year + PS rates; I'll update quote to include reserved commit + premium onprem support.
Raj (ACME Infra): We'll run internal GRC review and aim to reply in 5 business days. Thanks all :handshake:
